# ghost/tiktok

TikTok — user's-own-account actions: nav, account switching, self-stats, self-uploads. ToS-safe surface only.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/tiktok
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok open_my_profile --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok open_inbox --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok get_active_account --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok get_unread_count --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok get_my_stats --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok list_accounts --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok switch_account --device <serial> --param handle=<handle>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok upload_video --device <serial> --param video_path=<video_path> --param caption=<caption>
```

## Actions

- `open_my_profile`: Open my TikTok profile
- `open_inbox`: Open my TikTok inbox
- `get_active_account`: What TikTok account am I logged in as?
- `get_unread_count`: How many unread TikTok notifications do I have?
- `get_my_stats`: How many followers do I have on TikTok?
- `list_accounts`: List all my TikTok accounts on this phone
- `switch_account`: Switch to my my_other_account TikTok account
- `upload_video`: Upload cat.mp4 to TikTok as a draft with caption 'look at this' and hashtags #cat #fyp
